prompt: Which pair of reagents converts a ketone to the corresponding methylene (CH₂) without touching an acid-sensitive group?

options.label: Clemmensen: Zn(Hg), HCl (acidic — not good for acid-sensitive)

explanation: Both WK and Clemmensen reduce C=O → CH₂. WK (basic) spares acid-sensitive substrates; Clemmensen (strong acid) spares base-sensitive substrates.
